rows.proof: `DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE JUNE 30, 2015`, PDF pages 42-43 of the FY2015 annual town report -- ONE table across two pages, 16 debt issues against 32 fiscal years FY2016-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. THE PAGES ARE MIRRORED AND ROTATED IN THEIR OWN TEXT LAYER, like page 34: the words read backwards and what scans as a row at constant `top` is a COLUMN, so every word is reversed and the table is transposed before anything is read. No recognition is involved. THE YEAR COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED: each `top` band carries its own four-digit year label, read and checked -- page 42 runs FY2032 at top=42 down to FY2016 at top=581, page 43 carries TOTAL at top=41 and FY2047 at 80 down to FY2033 at 573. Increasing `top` is right-to-left on the printed page. THE ROW GRID IS THE PAGE'S OWN ROW LABELS: every row prints PRINCIPAL, INTEREST or TOTAL, which gives 51 row anchors on each page -- 16 issues x 3 rows, plus GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT -- and the two pages carry the same 16 issues in the same order, matched by name. THIS FILE IS THE THREE PRINTED GRAND TOTAL ROWS, one row per fiscal year, exactly as the page prints them. Each year closes on its own: grand total principal plus grand total interest is total debt, 32 of 32 years, to the dollar. WHAT DOES NOT CLOSE IS THE DOCUMENT, and all three columns are attested rather than tolerated: the 32 printed years of GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL add to $19,951,201 against the $49,556,201 the same row prints in its TOTAL cell, and the $29,605,000 between them is EXACTLY the two MS-HS CONSTRUCTION issues -- and exactly the `Schools` figure page 41 prints outside the general debt limit. The interest row is short $17,755,661 against those issues' printed interest totals of $5,195,300 and $12,560,362, a dollar apart because of the same $5 the detail file attests. THE DOCUMENT'S OWN GRAND TOTAL ROWS ARE INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT, AND THIS IS THE FINDING OF THE PAGE. In every one of the thirty year columns where they pay, the two MS-HS CONSTRUCTION issues ($9,000,000 and $20,605,000) are EXCLUDED from GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT -- the printed FY2033 grand total principal is $82,050, which is exactly MUNICIPAL PURPOSE SEWER $49,018 plus MUNICIPAL PURPOSE WATER $33,032 and leaves out MS-HS $320,000 and $730,000 printed two rows above it. The TOTAL column of those same three rows DOES include them: $49,556,201 of principal is the sum of all sixteen issues, and page 41's `Total Long-Term Indebtedness` for 2015 prints $49,556,203 with $29,605,000 of Schools debt outside the general debt limit, which is the two MS-HS issues together. THIS WAS CHECKED BY EYE, NOT INFERRED: page 43 was rendered and looked at, and the grand total rows are printed in blue beneath the MS-HS blocks with those columns visibly blank of them. WHAT FOLLOWS FOR A READER: the town's published per-year forward debt service for FY2016 onward understates the town's own total by the school construction debt, which is $29.6M of the $49.6M outstanding. The per-ISSUE rows are complete and are what should be used.

rows.proof: `DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE JUNE 30, 2015`, PDF pages 42-43 of the FY2015 annual town report -- ONE table across two pages, SIXTEEN debt issues against 32 fiscal years FY2016-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. THE COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED: the `FISCAL YEAR` stub row carries its own four-digit year per column and each was read -- page 42 runs FY2032 at top=41.8 down to FY2016 at top=581, page 43 carries TOTAL at top=38.9 and FY2047 at 79.7 down to FY2033 at 502+. Increasing `top` is right-to-left on the printed page. THE ROW GRID IS THE PAGE'S OWN ROW LABELS, read and written down: each issue is a block of four printed rows -- the issue name, then PRINCIPAL, INTEREST and TOTAL -- which gives 51 row anchors on each page (16 issues x 3, plus GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT). Both pages carry the same 51 anchors and the same sixteen issues in the same printed order, checked name by name. FIVE OF THE SIXTEEN ISSUES PRINT THE IDENTICAL NAME `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`, and that is why the first reading of these pages held TWELVE issues rather than sixteen: keyed on the printed name, the five collapsed into one and the later figures silently overwrote the earlier, which made the row sums nonsense (a `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` principal row summing to $1,420,000 against a printed TOTAL of $400,000). THE KEY HERE IS THE ISSUE'S PRINTED POSITION, 01 to 16, as well as its name. A printed label is not a unique identifier and nothing on this page says it is. THIS FILE IS THE TOTAL COLUMN, printed on page 43: what each of the sixteen issues owes in principal, interest and total over the whole of FY2016-FY2047. The year-by-year detail is `fy2015-p42-debt-by-issue.csv` and no figure is in both. WHAT PROVES IT: the sixteen rows sum, in the principal column, to the $49,556,201 the page's own GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL row prints in its TOTAL cell, and in the interest column to the printed $23,200,767 -- both EXACTLY, to the dollar. Fifteen of the sixteen rows also close on principal + interest = total. THE ONE THAT DOES NOT IS THE TOWN'S ARITHMETIC, AND IT IS NOW FULLY EXPLAINED. MASS WATER POOL 9* prints principal $3,373,156, interest $700,555 and total $3,655,007, which is $418,704 BELOW its own two components. $418,704 is exactly the FY2024 principal of that same issue -- its final payment year -- and page 42 prints NO total cell for MASS WATER POOL 9* in FY2024. So this row's TOTAL is footed on the printed YEAR TOTALS, of which FY2024's is blank, rather than on its own principal and interest. The 32 printed year totals of that row sum to $3,655,007 exactly, which is what confirms it. THE SAME $418,704 CARRIES INTO THE PAGE'S OWN GRAND TOTAL: the sixteen rows sum to $72,338,264 in the total column against a printed TOTAL DEBT of $72,756,968, a difference of exactly $418,704 in the same direction. So the town's grand total is consistent with principal plus interest and this one row is not, and the figure the document omits is identified rather than merely measured. WHAT IT DOES NOT SHOW: whether the blank FY2024 total cell is a typesetting omission or a deliberate statement about that payment. Nothing on either page distinguishes them, and no tolerance is or could be declared for a $418,704 difference -- it is named, not absorbed. -- closes: the Treasurer's own FY2015 debt service schedule, which is not published.

rows.proof: `DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE JUNE 30, 2015`, PDF pages 42-43 of the FY2015 annual town report -- ONE table across two pages, SIXTEEN debt issues against 32 fiscal years FY2016-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. THE COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED: the `FISCAL YEAR` stub row carries its own four-digit year per column and each was read -- page 42 runs FY2032 at top=41.8 down to FY2016 at top=581, page 43 carries TOTAL at top=38.9 and FY2047 at 79.7 down to FY2033 at 502+. Increasing `top` is right-to-left on the printed page. THE ROW GRID IS THE PAGE'S OWN ROW LABELS, read and written down: each issue is a block of four printed rows -- the issue name, then PRINCIPAL, INTEREST and TOTAL -- which gives 51 row anchors on each page (16 issues x 3, plus GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT). Both pages carry the same 51 anchors and the same sixteen issues in the same printed order, checked name by name. FIVE OF THE SIXTEEN ISSUES PRINT THE IDENTICAL NAME `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`, and that is why the first reading of these pages held TWELVE issues rather than sixteen: keyed on the printed name, the five collapsed into one and the later figures silently overwrote the earlier, which made the row sums nonsense (a `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` principal row summing to $1,420,000 against a printed TOTAL of $400,000). THE KEY HERE IS THE ISSUE'S PRINTED POSITION, 01 to 16, as well as its name. A printed label is not a unique identifier and nothing on this page says it is. THIS FILE IS THE TOTAL COLUMN, printed on page 43: what each of the sixteen issues owes in principal, interest and total over the whole of FY2016-FY2047. The year-by-year detail is `fy2015-p42-debt-by-issue.csv` and no figure is in both. WHAT PROVES IT: the sixteen rows sum, in the principal column, to the $49,556,201 the page's own GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL row prints in its TOTAL cell, and in the interest column to the printed $23,200,767 -- both EXACTLY, to the dollar. Fifteen of the sixteen rows also close on principal + interest = total. THE ONE THAT DOES NOT IS THE TOWN'S ARITHMETIC, AND IT IS NOW FULLY EXPLAINED. MASS WATER POOL 9* prints principal $3,373,156, interest $700,555 and total $3,655,007, which is $418,704 BELOW its own two components. $418,704 is exactly the FY2024 principal of that same issue -- its final payment year -- and page 42 prints NO total cell for MASS WATER POOL 9* in FY2024. So this row's TOTAL is footed on the printed YEAR TOTALS, of which FY2024's is blank, rather than on its own principal and interest. The 32 printed year totals of that row sum to $3,655,007 exactly, which is what confirms it. THE SAME $418,704 CARRIES INTO THE PAGE'S OWN GRAND TOTAL: the sixteen rows sum to $72,338,264 in the total column against a printed TOTAL DEBT of $72,756,968, a difference of exactly $418,704 in the same direction. So the town's grand total is consistent with principal plus interest and this one row is not, and the figure the document omits is identified rather than merely measured. WHAT IT DOES NOT SHOW: whether the blank FY2024 total cell is a typesetting omission or a deliberate statement about that payment. Nothing on either page distinguishes them, and no tolerance is or could be declared for a $418,704 difference -- it is named, not absorbed. -- closes: the Treasurer's own FY2015 debt service schedule, which is not published.
